entry.title: Microservices with Azure: What Actually Works in Production (and What Doesn't)
entry.summary:
The Microservices Promise vs. Reality
Every architecture diagram looks clean before it meets real traffic. Microservices on Azure promise independent deployability, team autonomy, granular scaling, and fault isolation. Those benefits are real — but they come with a cost that's rarely discussed honestly in tutorials: operational complexity that scales faster than your team does if you're not careful. This post isn't a beginner's introduction to microservices. It's an honest account of what we've learned building and running microservice architectures on Azure across multiple production systems — what the platform does well, where you'll get burned, and the specific patterns that separate systems that hold up from systems that fall apart at 3am. entry.title: My Journy to Build a Smart Hydroponic Grow Tent!! (Planning)
entry.summary:
I'm planning to build a smart hydroponic grow tent for growing baby leaf greens and automate the following functions in the following order with a Raspberry Pi.
I use a grow tent to control and stabilize the growing environment by reducing the effects of pests and external factors (such as weather and temperature). Light on/off Temperature/humidity monitoring Water level monitoring Alert notifications Fan control pH / EC management Aeration (air pump + air stone) Quantitative fertilizer injection Fixed-position camera monitoring Remote status monitoring via a dashboard There are two main hydroponic methods I considered for this grow tent: DWC and NFT. ・NFT → A system in which a thin layer of nutrient solution flows through an inclined channel. The roots are not completely submerged in water. I'm building a DWC-based hydroponic system because DWC seems easier to manage. In this post, I will summarize the overall project plan. ~Overview Schedule~ Build a grow tent Build one hydroponic setup Run a grow test without automation Add automation Add monitoring with a Raspberry Pi Expand to the second and third shelves In Step1, I will install a grow tent, multi-tier shelves, LED bar lights, small fans, waterproof trays. First, I bought these items. ・Grow tent https://amzn.asia/d/0dXkClGL ・multi-tier shelves ・LED bar lights https://amzn.asia/d/03EHS1wG ・Waterproof trays ・Styrofoam board https://jp.daisonet.com/products/4550480291680 ・Sponge I can find most of the materials I need for this hands-on project at DAISO and Seria (and sometimes at Amazon).
